title: Combat Pipeline
description: The formula trees of the combat pipeline (docs/core/combat.md).

pipeline.description: The attack pipeline of docs/core/combat.md: formula trees and the damage-type tags the steps read.

pierce_tag.description: Damage-type tag that swaps armor DR for pierce_dr.
